## Wave 2 Summary

This wave operationalizes my **topology/analysis boundary** — the Kasparov product (van den Dungen 2018/2022, Paper 01, Thm 3.4) factorizes the K-HOMOLOGY class `[D_total] = π_! ⊗_{C(M)} [D_M]` and gives TOPOLOGY (indices, mass ordering, c_s²=0, w_a=0), NOT the spectral-action MOMENTS (a₀, a₂, a₄ → Λ, G_N, Yang-Mills). That boundary BOUNDS what the framework's "computed" numbers actually are. Five gates, translating five of my survey's highest-leverage next-steps:

1. **INV12-W2-1** (compute, [SIGN]) — bound `|S_cross|/S_base` at one off-Jensen point (O'Neill A,T → Gilkey a₂(D_total²) product-correction). The additive factorization `a₂(D_total)=a₀(D_M)a₂(D_K)+a₂(D_M)a₀(D_K)` (→ G_N, Einstein-Hilbert, n_s) is proven only ON-Jensen (A-TENSOR-61: A=T=0 EXACT for product metric). Closes G-1 / U-1; tests U-3.
2. **INV12-W2-2** (solo) — pole-status ledger: tag every canonical a_n with (pole_in_s, curvature_grade n=d−2s, convergent? s>d/2). The §VII.CB S109 wall proved a₂ lives at the divergent pole; which other "from-the-cache" numbers are residue-subtracted-only (finite-L-unverifiable)? Closes G-3 / R-1.
3. **INV12-W2-3** (solo) — state + verify the Mesland–van den Dungen bounded-perturbation theorem (Paper 10, 1608.02506) for the BdG dressing: locally bounded ⇒ K-homology preserved EXACTLY (mass ordering, c_s²=0, w_a=0 safe even off-Jensen) while a_n shifts boundedly. Promotes S69 W5-G from per-case observation to structural theorem. Closes part of U-1 / C-2.
4. **INV12-W2-4** (compute, [SIGN]) — build the pseudo-Riemannian submersion spectral triple (timelike M⁴, Riemannian SU(3) fiber) per Paper 04 (1207.2112); test whether the Krein spectral action's a₀ equals the Euclidean a₀ that DILUTION-CC's Λ consumes. The "naive Wick rotation" (U-2) gets its first concrete test. Closes part of G-2 / U-2 / U-4; bridges B-1.
5. **INV12-W2-5** (compute, FWD-C1 cross-pillar-bridge LANDING) — build FWD-C1 via the Bismut-Cheeger η-form of the adiabatic-limit-breaking τ-family `{D_K(τ)}` across [0, τ_fold]; identify it with the integrated Bogoliubov pair-production (59.8 pairs). A NEW bridge-map class (adiabatic-limit η-form, NOT HKR — advances the Hybrid-Independence-Test K-counter via criterion (iii)); the principled handle on A_s (CF23 wall) that bypasses the failed slow-roll machinery. Closes G-4; bridges B-3. FULL 5-anatomy + 3-level discipline MANDATORY.

All five gates execute as `van-den-dungen-bridge-theorist`. Three computes (W2-1, W2-4, W2-5) + two solos (W2-2, W2-3). All five are compute/solo ⇒ all five emit a verdict line to the investigation-track ledger `computations/investigation-12/inv12_gate_verdicts.txt`.

    BOTH conventions per regulator-pin-discipline.md §"Mellin Pole-Set Labeling": double-power maps

    shell-sum convergence test: the partial sum L^{d−2s} converges iff s > d/2 = 4. Tag each a_n
    convergent? (s>4) or DIVERGENT (s≤4, residue-subtracted-only). (4) Cross-validate against the
    §VII.CB S107/S108/S109 verdicts (the a₂ canary, double-power s=3<4 ⇒ DIVERGENT, confirmed Weyl-

gate_id: "INV12-W2-4-KREIN-LORENTZIAN-A0"

    dimensions / heat-kernel leading coefficient, which is a Weyl-invariant). The [SIGN] claim is the
    EQUALITY direction (a₀^{Krein} = a₀^{Eucl}). (4) D_K block-diagonal; the fiber SU(3) sector is
    unchanged (Riemannian); only the M⁴ base flips signature, so the comparison localizes to the base
    a₀ factor. PASS = a₀^{Krein} = a₀^{Eucl} to tolerance (naive Wick rotation validated for Λ);
    FAIL = they differ (the CC number shifts; U-2 confirmed load-bearing).
  producing_script: "computations/investigation-12/inv12_w2_4_krein_lorentzian_a0.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

  form: "|a₀^{Krein} − a₀^{Eucl}| / |a₀^{Eucl}| <= tau_PASS  (relative equality of the Krein vs Euclidean zeroth heat-kernel moment)"

machinery_pin_map:

  L_max: "12"                              # master spectrum cache for the fiber a₀ factor; base a₀ is the Weyl volume term
  scan_range: "N/A — two-point comparison (Krein vs Euclidean a₀)"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "1.0e-3"                      # relative equality tolerance (PASS boundary)
  scheme: "Krein-FW"                       # Krein spectral action, framework convention
  convention: "RATIO"                      # relative |Δa₀|/|a₀^Eucl|
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg"                 # AMD RX 9070 XT for the fiber heat-kernel block
  regulator_pin: "a_0^{Mellin}"            # a₀ is the load-bearing Seeley-DeWitt moment compared. poleconv-A-double: a₀ at (pole_in_s=4, curvature_grade_n=0); s=4 = d/2 (MARGINAL — boundary of convergence, the volume/Weyl pole). BOTH a₀^{Krein} and a₀^{Eucl} use the same Mellin regulator (the comparison is regulator-matched by construction — only the SIGNATURE differs, not the regulator).
  CLASS: "FULL"                            # full physical Krein construction (Paper 04 indefinite heat-kernel), NOT a SCHEMATIC helper — a₀ computed from the genuine indefinite D², not a _spectral_action_regulators.py analog
  J_convention: "Krein-linear-J2=+1"       # CRITICAL: the Krein fundamental symmetry J is LINEAR, J²=+1 (Paper 04/08), DISTINCT from Connes' antilinear real-structure J (J²=±1). The framework uses Connes' J elsewhere; this gate uses the Krein J. Mis-identifying the two is the canonical convention failure (my survey R-4 / memory J-ambiguity warning).

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "a₀^{Krein} = a₀^{Eucl} (the naive Wick rotation is validated for the Λ leg)."

    Step 1 (Definitions):
      a₀^{Eucl} [Gilkey 1995; framework DILUTION-CC]:

        on the pseudo-Riemannian (timelike M⁴, Riemannian SU(3)) triple, with Tr_J the J-weighted

          term, which counts the spinor-bundle rank — a Weyl invariant INDEPENDENT of signature (the
          number of eigenvalues, not their sign). So Tr_J(1_H)|_{a₀-relevant} = Tr(1_H)|_{a₀-relevant}.
